prompts.name: worked_algebra
prompts.prompt: Explain how to solve quadratic equations by completing the square. Give two different worked examples and show every algebraic step.

prompts.name: json_inventory
prompts.prompt: Write a JSON array of twelve fictional library books. Each object must include title, author, year, genre, and a one-sentence description. Return only JSON.

prompts.name: planning_dialogue
prompts.prompt: Write a dialogue between two engineers planning a small solar-powered weather station. Discuss sensor choice, battery capacity, data storage, and maintenance, with at least twelve exchanges.
